note: Anonymous prototype feedback survey (Google Forms) taken after using the live prototype. Open answers coded by the team into themes.

questions.Q1: Which best describes your current role?
questions.Q2: When you first opened the tool, what did you try to do first?
questions.Q3: How easy was it to understand what this tool is for within the first minute?
questions.Q4: Map & Profile tab - Were you able to find and click on a specific neighborhood or county?
questions.Q4a: If no or couldn’t figure it out, what got in the way?
questions.Q5: Compare Measures tab - Did the parallel coordinates chart help you see a relationship between two health measures?
questions.Q5a: What would have made it more useful?
questions.Q6: Similar & Unusual tab - Did the peer finder (finding neighborhoods with similar health profiles) make sense to you?
questions.Q7: Care Gaps tab - Were you able to identify at least one area with high disease burden and weak preventive care?
questions.Q8: Did the uncertainty indicators (whiskers on charts, ⚠ warning flags) change how you interpreted any estimate?
questions.Q9: Guided Story - Did you try the Guided Story button?
questions.Q9a: If yes - how useful was the guided story for understanding the tool?
questions.Q9b: What would you change about the guided story, or what was missing from it?
questions.Q10: Which tab did you find most useful for your work or field?
questions.Q11: Was there anything you wanted to do that you couldn’t figure out how to do?
questions.Q12: Were there any moments where you felt lost or unsure what to do next?
questions.Q13: Could you read and distinguish the colors on the map comfortably?
questions.Q13a: If you had difficulty, please describe it
questions.Q14: Was the amount of information on screen at one time manageable?
questions.Q15: Would this tool change how you currently work with health data?
questions.Q16: What is the single most important thing you’d want changed or added before the final version?
questions.Q17:
We’d love to hear your feedback!
In a few words, let us know whether you liked the dashboard, what you found useful, or anything you think could be improved. All feedback, suggestions, and comments are welcome and appreciated!

themes.label: Parallel coordinates: focus and clutter
themes.change: Selected tract drawn bold with value labels, highlighted lines in front, five measure presets, line legend, labelled focus axis, hover shows exact values

themes.label: One connected story across the views
themes.change: Overview tab that maps the question to each view; guided story rebuilt around one question and one tract, with transitions and a recap

themes.label: In-context explanations of charts
themes.change: "How to read" notes on parallel coordinates, whiskers, peers and the care-gap legend; plain-language tooltips

themes.label: Save, export or share a view
themes.change: Download CSV, printable summary report, PNG export with caption and source, shareable links that keep the selection

themes.label: Color contrast and legend size
themes.change: High-contrast option for groups and lines; larger legend text

themes.label: Where to start / too much at once
themes.change: Overview tab with five quick-start questions and one primary next step

themes.label: A practical outreach example
themes.change: Story follows a real outreach question; recap card with a downloadable outreach list

themes.label: Data source and update date
themes.change: Data source, release and refresh date shown in the header and Overview; fresh-data workflow on GitHub Actions

themes.label: Explain uncertainty and methods
themes.change: Uncertainty legend beside the profile, methods & limitations panel, exact CI in tooltips and exports

themes.label: Make cross-view linking obvious
themes.change: Persistent "following" bar, same tract outlined in every view, link captions on every card

themes.label: Explain how similarity is computed

themes.label: Compare a few chosen areas side by side
